content.short: Pretium lets people and businesses pay with stablecoins in Africa, settling instantly in local fiat.
content.description: Pretium is stablecoin payment infrastructure for Africa, with instant fiat settlement across more than seven markets through a consumer wallet, developer APIs and agentic payments for AI agents. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Pretium.
content.meta: Pretium offers stablecoin payments with instant local fiat settlement across Africa, listed on Stable.
